query_text: Find every investigational anticancer therapeutic directed at guanylyl cyclase C (GUCY2C, also called GCC or GC-C) that has entered human clinical testing (Phase 1 or later) at any time up to the as-of date, including programs that were later discontinued, terminated or withdrawn. Any modality qualifies (antibody-drug conjugate, T-cell engager or other bispecific, CAR-T or other cell therapy, vaccine, radioligand, naked antibody). Exclude GUCY2C agonist peptides developed for gastrointestinal motility or functional bowel disorders, diagnostic or imaging-only agents, and programs that never entered human trials. For each asset report all names and development codes, target, modality, and every associated clinical trial registration.
